description.value: Hooray Coffee is a specialty coffee shop tagged in OSM as serving both coffee and sushi, located at street level in a Burnaby commercial building. The associated website operates as 'Hooray Coffee Lab', an active specialty coffee roastery offering curated single-origin beans — including a 2026 Yunnan Wanderlust collection — alongside brewing equipment. Cyclists will find a takeout-friendly stop with a strong coffee focus and an unusual food pairing in sushi.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record has a check_date of 2025-11-15, confirming the location is recently verified. The website (hooraycoffee.ca) is active and branded as 'Hooray Coffee Lab', primarily presenting as an e-commerce specialty coffee roaster selling whole-bean coffee and brewing gear online — it does not corroborate the physical address, phone number, or the OSM-described sushi component. OSM explicitly tags toilets=no (negative evidence for washrooms) and takeaway=yes (positive for takeout); all other cyclist amenities are unaddressed by either source.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Hooray Coffee' but the website is branded 'Hooray Coffee Lab' throughout.
Community field lists 'North Vancouver' but postal code V5G4E1 is in Burnaby, BC — the OSM node may be miscommunity-tagged.

Website is almost entirely e-commerce (online bean sales, gear, shipping policies) with no mention of the physical address, phone number, or in-person sushi service described in OSM — the online presence and the physical location may represent two distinct aspects of the business that are not well integrated on the site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating business with a recently checked OSM record (2025-11-15) and an active website. A functioning coffee and takeout stop useful to touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: active specialty coffee roastery offering curated single-origin beans … takeaway=yes … toilets=no
